pages.title: Diving in Sweden
pages.extract: Diving in Sweden can be somewhat underestimated. The waters are very cold and dark, the bottom composition is often muddy and you will most likely need a drysuit in all seasons. Despite that, there are plenty of fantastic destinations and unique features such as the preservation of submerged objects. The low salinity of the Baltic Sea means the shipworms are absent and wooden hulls can last for centuries.

pages.title: Expeditions
pages.extract:
The term expedition has several meanings, most of them relevant to travel.
Any travel that requires serious planning can be considered an expedition. Examples on Wikivoyage include:

Next-to-impossible destinations
Mountaineering
Wilderness backpacking
From Istanbul to Cairo and other long journeys; see Itineraries index
On Wikivoyage we have projects that bring people together to improve some aspect of the site, and these are referred to as "expeditions". Active examples as of early 2022 include the Wikivoyage:India Expedition and Wikivoyage:Airport Expedition. For a full list, see Wikivoyage:Expeditions.

pages.title: South China
pages.description: geographical and cultural region that covers the southernmost part of China
pages.extract:
South China has always been outward-looking. Many of China's mariners and traders have come from this region and many overseas Chinese can trace their ancestry to South China.
All of the provinces in this region have coastlines, but Guangxi is best known for its karst limestone terrain, with fantastically gum drop-shaped hills which have inspired traditional Chinese landscape painting for centuries.
This region of China has looked toward the sea for thousands of years, with Canton (as it was then known to Europeans) being an important trading port. Today, it is again a major center for trade; Guangdong alone produces a third of China's exports, and the other provinces of the region are also very much open for business. Four of China's six Special Economic Zones — areas with tax breaks and other government measures to encourage trade and development — are in this region.
